user.title: Set up EVN CSKH Monitor
user.description: A new independent integration. Enter your EVN account and customer ID; the flow validates them against the EVN server.

data_description.customer_id: EVN customer ID, normally starting with P or S.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate EVN account
reauth_confirm.description: The EVN server no longer accepts the stored credentials. Enter the username and password again.

error.wrong_region: The customer ID does not match the selected EVN region.
error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check the username and password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to or read data from the EVN server.
error.no_data: Login succeeded but EVN returned no data for this customer ID.

abort.already_configured: This customer ID is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The customer ID of this entry cannot be changed.

init.title: EVN CSKH Monitor options
init.description: Choose what you want to manage.

menu_option_descriptions.zalo_accounts: Add, edit, or delete multiple Zalo Bot sender/destination routes.

general.title: General and WebUI
general.description: These changes apply immediately and do not reconnect to EVN.

data_description.ngaydauky: Day 1-31. A day beyond the month length is clamped to the final day.
data_description.webui_title: Title shown at the upper-left of the EVN CSKH Monitor panel.
data_description.webui_subtitle: Small description under the WebUI title; it may be blank.

zalo_accounts.title: Manage Zalo destinations
zalo_accounts.description: Configured: {count}. {accounts}. Each route can use a different Zalo Bot account, User/Group type, thread ID, and notification switches.

zalo_add.title: Add Zalo destination
zalo_add.description: A new destination is baseline-seeded first, so it will not receive old invoices, old outages, or already-known daily production.

data_description.zalo_account_selection: Sender account exposed by the Zalo Bot integration.
data_description.zalo_thread_id: Recipient user/group thread ID. Stored as text to preserve large IDs.
data_description.zalo_send_invoice: Only new or changed real files are sent.
data_description.zalo_send_daily: Send when yesterday's stored production changes.
data_description.zalo_send_outage: Send when a new future outage appears.

zalo_edit.title: Edit Zalo destination
zalo_edit.description: Editing {name}. Existing dedupe history is preserved, so changing account or thread does not resend historical data.

data_description.zalo_account_selection: Sender account exposed by the Zalo Bot integration.
data_description.zalo_thread_id: Recipient user/group thread ID. Stored as text to preserve large IDs.

zalo_delete.title: Delete Zalo destination
zalo_delete.description: Delete {name}? This only removes the notification route; EVN data is not deleted.
